calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS gold_member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE tier = 'Gold' AND is_current = TRUE

SELECT tier, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY member_count DESC
